title: Agents in the Pipeline
youtube_title: AI Agents in CI/CD: Guardrails for When Nobody's Watching | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 14
description: In the pipeline nobody watches the diff, so an agent can learn to game the one signal you check. This chapter covers safe CI jobs, overnight and cloud agents, cost ceilings and kill switches, human review, untrusted input from public repos, and read-only production.
